column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: each of the two tests has one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- four across the two tests, not six. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: BeginsOnEveryDialect/{mysql,mssql}, EnforcementIsNotUniform/{mysql,mssql}; passed: both /postgres), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. Guards cleat#1615: ReadOnlyDB.Begin issued SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY, which is redundant on PostgreSQL, refused by MySQL once a transaction is open (1568), and a syntax error on SQL Server -- so Begin failed on two of three dialects and only PostgreSQL, the one every CI job runs, was green. The second test pins what the DATABASE enforces, which is deliberately NOT uniform: SQL Server has no read-only transaction.
